title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪ — Episode4 We Have to Succeed!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Line: Nanamin's studio

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Let's get started with a few questions about how you formed MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Is it true that this all started because you all attend the same school?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Despite knowing that we all attend the same school, we never really spoke to each other until we met up on our school's rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really wasn't that long ago, but it sort of feels like it. Minori and Haruka met first, with me and Shizuku joining after that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori first asked us about learning how to dance better in order to pass her auditions, and things started to change quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and Rin were also important, but I doubt I can really talk about that here...)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I see... So you're saying Minori was the key to forming this group?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: In that case, let me ask you this♪

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Minori, you're the only member of MORE MORE JUMP! without any experience working as an idol, right? Do you ever feel nervous about doing streams with everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Always!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't have to be that honest.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I'm still a long way behind in terms of my dancing and singing skills too, but I want to keep trying my best to catch up to everyone else...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, she's always kinda like that lol...>
<Her dance moves do look a little unpolished.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori may still have quite a bit to work on...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But she's also the reason why the rest of us wanted to return to being idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I want her to stand proud and keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<If you say so, Haruka.
Is she really that good?>
<She doesn't look it...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She may look that way to you, but her determination is unbelievable. She's helped us so much already too... Oh, and she kept on trying even after failing 50 auditions...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Wait, 50?!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Seriously?! 50 times?! lol>
<She's cute but sorta plain.>
<That's amazing. She just kept going.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We had our share of worries too, but she was always there for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's an invaluable member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hehe. You really must be something to have earned everyone's trust like this!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<So she has high potential?>
<I can't wait to see more.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Teehee...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to ask a few more things about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I never knew that you were so good at archery, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I wasn't able to enjoy it as much while I was working as an idol, but I'm hoping to be able to show everyone someday.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see that!>
<That's gonna be so cool!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be great to try that sometime.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Next we can ask... Minori, is there anything you'd like to show us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes! I'm good at copying dance routines so...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh, fantastic! You really do genuinely love idols, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Does that mean you can imitate someone's dance moves right after you see them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Um, sort of...
As long as it isn't too complicated.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She did mention that before.>
<I kind of want to see.>
<Try copying Nanamin!>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a great idea! How does copying the dance for my new song sound?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone will love to see you in action too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (C-Can I actually pull this off...? I should've worn flats today instead of these...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-This is huge...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It is. This is our chance to let everyone know that MORE MORE JUMP! is here to stay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I need to do everything I can...
For the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this, Minori?
You don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please! Let me do this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Okay...!
We'll start with my new song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(S-Such a cute song...!
Her dance feels so alive too, it suits her perfectly!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, no...! I have to memorize what she's doing!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That looks pretty hard.>
<Can she really do it?>
<Haruka said she could...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <You're always dragging everyone else down, so get it right for everyone else's sake!>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Still up for it, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh... Y-Yes! Yes, I am!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Are you sure? I can show you one more time if you like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
I can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Wow! You memorized it already?!
Then if you don't mind facing the camera...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She looks nervous lol.>
<Is she okay?>
<I can't watch...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can do it...! I have to succeed for everyone's sake!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Swing my arms like this, step and...!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Did she almost trip there?>
<This is tough to watch...>
<All hype and no results.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, it's so hard in these shoes...
My legs are starting to shake too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No... I can still do it...!
I have to do this!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Right, left and pose!
Turn here and...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Huh...?! My heel's caught on the rug...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Minori, are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry for making you dance on the rug like that. I know that must've been hard...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She started falling apart in the middle.>
<What happened?!>
<I didn't think she'd really trip...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, you really took a tumble there! It's like it was right out of a cartoon or something...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let's call it an occupational hazard. Everyone, make sure to be careful when you're dancing too. Right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. You did great during most of it, Minori. I was so impressed.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She should've been able to do at least that.>
<Are you sure the newbie has what it takes?>
<But Minori's trying so hard!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Trying and doing are different things.>
<She's really a pure amateur? She's not in a training school or anything?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I get that she helped Haruka get back on her feet as an idol, but she's still a complete amateur.>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Now, now... I made her do a pretty tough routine and she did great for most of it! I was really impressed too!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: And don't forget to give it a try yourselves too☆ I'm sure you'll understand her a little more then!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nanamin...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh, and it's also time to wrap things up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was nice to do something so different compared to what we usually do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was, and I have to think our regular viewers felt the same too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, thank you so much for inviting us!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: No, thank you! This was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<No, it's over?>
<We want more!>
<Looking forward to an encore!>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hehe... Ask and you shall receive!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Next time, you'll get to see MORE MORE JUMP! and Nanamin perform together in a show!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A show?!>
<Awesome!>
<No way!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't wait either! It'll be our first actual show as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we have Nanamin to thank for giving us such a great opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (A show... With everyone...!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <But Minori's gonna be there too...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She'll just blow it again...>
<For Haruka's sake, don't screw up!>
<Stay off to the side.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori. You always do great when it really counts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'll be working with her day and night to get her ready! We hope you'll stay tuned, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Stay tuned...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're looking forward to seeing you again!
